title: Bug bash: demo data, personas, shared kit and server modules
story: As the sponsor I want the demo data and personas to tell a coherent story (auto claimant with vehicles, agent with produced policies, sensible dates) and every API the apps call to exist and allow the right roles
acceptance: Every defect assigned to area 'data' is fixed with a regression test, or explained

Each tenant's claimant persona holds a personal auto policy with vehicles and a consistent last name and ZIP; the agent persona produces seeded policies; demo claims have plausible loss and report dates
Audit clean for shared kit and API errors across all personas; full npm test: no new failures
brief: Defect list comes from the audit phase. Do not edit tests/unit/web, tests/unit/adjuster, tests/unit/config (other fixers own them).
